watchdog_checks.filtered_structural_pairs: All thirteen exact filtered pairs remain absent from the solver manifold on each step.
watchdog_checks.arm_path_and_tcp: Track phase-specific frozen inverse-kinematic setpoints and TCP reference as the arm moves; hold the achieved final target reference while closing.
watchdog_checks.object_table_contacts: Classify all registered body/link identities. Only finger pads may touch the target. Any robot-table solver manifold fails. Evaluate object support separately.
watchdog_checks.registered_base_table_mount: The one registered filtered mount must retain its signed-distance baseline, fixed relative transform, witness identity and finite geometry on every returned step. Its solver manifold must remain absent.
watchdog_checks.arm_motor_saturation: Read all six arm motor torques; stop on saturation against the submitted finite ceilings.
watchdog_checks.filtered_wrist_closest: At post-filter zero and every physical step, audit raw signed wrist/palm distance against the frozen mounting baseline, both mounting faces, signed normal, relative transform and the absence of a solver manifold.
watchdog_checks.unknown_contact: Any contact outside the phase-specific registered set, at any load, fails.
watchdog_checks.dynamic_slide_limit_band: Retain actual q; stop outside [-1e-5,0.07001] m. Command limits remain [0,0.070] m.
watchdog_checks.initial_contact_impulse: First actual integrated step, residual impulse/contact must be examined.
watchdog_checks.q0_pad_pad_contact: Opposing pads at the closed endpoint: keep raw witnesses; only finite registered tangent-band, zero-force/zero-impulse rows may qualify under the active-seam thresholds.
watchdog_checks.palm_finger_root_contact: Check current closest, shared faces and prismatic relation for four filtered sliding pairs; any solver manifold fails.
watchdog_checks.fixed_pad_mounts: Audit fixed left/right pad mounts before filtering, preserve closest geometry and require empty solver manifolds after filtering.
watchdog_checks.registered_active_seams: Only opposite pads may have an active manifold. Apply projected normal residual, signed distance, unit normal, forces and impulse limits; log tangential offset. Current closest supplies independent shared-face evidence.
